description: Created leakage-free validation split of 10,000 S1 entities and 434,567 targets
Evaluated 7 blocker configurations; selected AdvancedBlocker(max_posting_size=100, use_prefix3=True) with stop-word filtering
Trained LightGBM v2 + XGBoost v2 on 32 features; evaluated ensemble blend at threshold 0.995
Processed first batch of 5,000 test S1 records; saved checkpoint and flushed output lines
